METADATA.description: Find your Fender model and explore its value guide, with year-by-year prices, condition notes and Joe's own photos of vintage electric guitars and basses.

OUTLINE: Not Sure Which Fender You Have?
BODY:
# Vintage Fender Value Guide

Choose your Fender model to find its value guide. I've gathered the guitar and bass guides here so you can go straight to the year, finish and condition that match yours.

[IMAGE 1]

## Find Your Fender Model

Open a guide for its year-by-year references, condition notes and original photographs. Each model has its own comparisons.

### Stratocaster

[IMAGE 2]

Find the year guide for your Strat, with finish, originality and condition comparisons.

[Explore The Stratocaster Value Guide](/vintage-fender-stratocaster-value-guide/)

### Telecaster

[IMAGE 3]

Follow the Broadcaster, Nocaster and Telecaster family to the matching year guide.

[Explore The Telecaster Value Guide](/vintage-fender-telecaster-value-guide/)

### Esquire

[IMAGE 4]

Use the Esquire's own year and finish references, including blonde and custom color examples.

[Explore The Esquire Value Guide](/vintage-fender-esquire-value-guide/)

### Jazzmaster

[IMAGE 5]

Compare gold guards, slab boards, later necks and custom colors in the annual guide.

[Explore The Jazzmaster Value Guide](/vintage-fender-jazzmaster-value-guide/)

### Jaguar

[IMAGE 6]

Find Jaguar comparisons by year, with notes on original finishes, parts and condition.

[Explore The Jaguar Value Guide](/vintage-fender-jaguar-value-guide/)

### Mustang

[IMAGE 7]

Compare standard and Competition Mustangs, with annual references and model history.

[Explore The Mustang Value Guide](/post/fender-mustang-history-value/)

### Precision Bass

[IMAGE 8]

Choose the early slab-body, contoured or later Precision comparison for your bass.

[Explore The Precision Bass Value Guide](/vintage-fender-precision-bass-value-guide/)

### Jazz Bass

[IMAGE 9]

Find stack-knob and later Jazz Bass comparisons, with year, finish and condition notes.

[Explore The Jazz Bass Value Guide](/vintage-fender-jazz-bass-value-guide/)

## Before You Compare Your Fender

Start with the model, then match the year and configuration in its guide. I keep the condition assumptions beside the comparisons, so you can see how finish wear, repairs, changed parts and the case affect the reference you're using.

If you haven't established the year, my [Fender serial number and dating guide](/fender-guitars-serial-number-guide/) is a starting point. For a question about the finish, use my [Fender custom color authentication guide](/post/fender-custom-color-authentication-guide/).

You don't need to take the instrument apart before getting in touch. Keep its case, paperwork and any removed original parts together, and tell me about the changes you know of.


## Questions About Fender Values

### Where Can I Find A Price Range For My Fender?

Choose your model above, then find the year and configuration in its guide. I've kept the price tables and condition notes together on those model pages so you can read the assumptions with each comparison.

### What If I Don't Know The Model Or Year?

Send me clear photographs of the whole instrument, both sides of the headstock and its case, along with any history you know. You don't need to remove the neck or open the electronics before getting in touch.

### Can I Use The Guide If My Fender Has Changed Parts?

Yes. Read the condition notes in the model guide and describe the changes you know about. A clean original and a repaired or modified instrument need different comparisons, so don't assume the same range applies to both.

### Do The Model Guides Include Bass Guitars?

Yes. The Precision Bass and Jazz Bass each have a dedicated value guide. I've linked both here so you can go straight to the bass model and its covered years.
